text: 创业板指跌超3%，沪指跌超1%，深成指跌2.21%，贵金属、消费电子、算力硬件、农业等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4500只
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 3%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell more than 1%, and the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.21%, with precious metals, consumer electronics, computing power hardware, agriculture and other sectors leading the declines; nearly 4,500 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
